hero.headline: Smart green space management for livable cities
hero.description: Green Ecolution is an open-source solution for the efficient irrigation of urban trees. Our software combines sensor data with intelligent route optimization, enabling targeted, resource-efficient deployment planning. Developed in collaboration with the City of Flensburg, and soon available for your municipality too.
